page0.text:
It's clear that the longer I wait, the greater my disadvantage will become.
That means I should escape these dire straits while I can still move.
I'll charge in and cut the old mage down before the bugs surrounding me on all sides can crawl up my body!

page1.text:
It doesn't feel like I got him.
My diagonal slash slices easily through him like a tomato, and the pieces fall to the floor.

page2.text:
"Oh! I see, I see. You're very decisive, boy!"
The fallen pieces of the old mage laugh at me.

page3.text:
"Argh...!"
The kyousaku stick rots and crumbles in my hands.
He got me.
That old devil gave up his body to destroy my Strengthened stick...!

page4.text:
"You're cornered. In your passion, you lost your only weapon. The young ones are always so impatient."
"...!"

page5.text:
I run.
Bugs squish and crunch under my feet as I move.
I feel death closing in from behind,
and in a desperate bid to avoid the buzzing wave of insects,
I throw my shoulder against one of the dark walls leading outside...!

page6.text:
"I got out...!"
I roll out of the room, preserving my momentum.

page7.text:
"Hah...!"
The bugs don't follow me.
In my dazed sprint to escape the shrine, I ended up on the opposite side of the temple yard.

page8.text:
"Ow..."
I feel pain throughout my body. Maybe I hit something when I fell out of the building.
"But so what? More importantly, right now..."

page9.text:
I need to find Saber as soon as possible.
A feeling of dread hangs over me.
The anxiety gets worse and worse. I need to see Saber's face soon, or...

page10.text:
"...!"
The water ripples.
Sensing danger, I leap away from it.

page11.text:
The moist ground lets go of my feet.
"Ngh...!?"
But I only manage to jump back briefly.

page12.text:
Dull pain.
Something feels wrong with my heels, and I look down.

page13.text:
"Wha..."
They're all red.
When I jumped, both of my feet fell off, like discarded shoes...

page14.text:
"Those things back there..."
When I escaped the shrine room, I trampled on countless bugs.
I recall how my Strengthened stick rotted away when I used it to cut Zouken's body.
It stands to reason that my feet, which stepped on those same bugs, would meet the same fate.

page15.text:
"Ergh, guh...!"
On my hands and knees, I try to escape the bog on the remaining stumps of my feet.

page16.text:
"Haha. So close, boy. Your decision wasn't wrong, but you lacked the power to back it up."
The insect-user's voice resonates.
—The ground is muddy.
Spiders have always lived in wet places.

page17.text:
"Now, I have Saber.
Such a pity. You've lost the only reason for me to keep you alive."
